detail.longDescription: Okay, so here is the official # Github Repo for # Sims4Access , the acessibility mod for the Sims 4 which I've been working on for a while now. Source code and everything is there, anyone who wants to change it or fork it or whatever, have at it, just follow the MIT license and things will be cool. https:// github.com/LeonianUniverse478/ Sims4Access
